reviews.text: Paradisus Is a resort I am okay not visiting again. We had a lot of issues. First off, it’s extremely hot inside the hotel (lobby, dining areas in our rooms). Food had no taste or flavor.
reviews.author: Leena

reviews.text:
Customer Service was excellent, the wait staff and bartenders were some of the friendly people we have encountered during any stays in Mexico. 
Our room was always cleaned and restocked within a short time frame.
The ocean view was great and the pool was beautiful and very well maintained. The grounds/gardens were beautiful. 
The only downfall was the food, the speciality restaurants were not that good at all. The buffet was a great morning place to eat but you had to be careful about the food being cold. 
We put in a repair order for our room but never got it fixed while we were there.
Would we go back...yes but would need to figure out a different food.
reviews.author: Hazel

reviews.text: Since day one we were treated really great by everyone. Will definitely come back

reviews.text: Me encantó 100% recomendable

reviews.text: Great property that was perfect for our family.
reviews.author: Gennaro

reviews.text: Las habitaciones estan remodeladas y eso esta bien. Sin embargo la calidad de la comida bajó muchísimo en comparación hace 5 años atrás! Me hospedé alli porque era el resort con la mejor comida de la ciudad...pero todo cambió.El personal excelente.
reviews.author: SANDRO

reviews.text:
We had an incredible stay at Paradisus. The resort was absolutely beautiful, clean, and staff was so generous. We loved our spa experience, but the jacuzzi should be warmer.  The gym and the equipment was very nice and it was so clean in there as well. As for the restaurants, we loved Kao, Santé for dinner and Vibra for breakfast! The buffet was also great but hit or miss on some days as they would run out of some items so early. Capella was Italian, could be better and service seemed a bit rushed there.  Sals steakhouse was amazing! The 24 hour ice cream
always ran out of ice cream by 10pm, but their coffee was delicious! The snack restaurant by the pool had good food, but one day they didn’t open until 2:00 pm. Get the burger there it’s the best! As for the rooms, they were nice and clean, however, we did have some issues with our power going out the first night, light fixture issue the second night, and temperature in our room was a bit warm that we had to have the fan on at all times. As for our concierge, Israel was wonderful! He was on top of all our requests at all times and always went above and beyond for us. He was the best! Overall, 10/10 and we will definitely be back!
reviews.author: sheryll Payumo

reviews.text:
My family and I had a wonderful stay at Reserve Tower. The service was exceptional, and the atmosphere was peaceful and quiet throughout our visit. Our room was spotless, beautifully maintained, and offered stunning views that made our stay even more enjoyable.
Restaurants high end. 
A special thank you to Galindo, our concierge, who took outstanding care of us from start to finish. The concierge service operates through WhatsApp, which was incredibly convenient, and Galindo was always quick to respond, coordinate requests, and ensure everything we needed was taken care of promptly.
His attention to detail and genuine care made us feel welcomed and valued. We truly appreciated the excellent hospitality and look forward to returning in the future. Highly recommended!
reviews.author: Noel

reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Our family just returned from an incredible 11 night stay at Paradisus Cancun, and we are already talking about when we can come back!
What truly made this vacation unforgettable was the amazing staff. A huge thank you to Bernardo, Armando, Pascual, Alejandro, and Seferino from the Gastro Hall. They welcomed us every day with genuine kindness and warmth and truly made us feel at home. Their service was exceptional, and seeing their friendly faces became one of our favorite parts of each day.
A special shout-out to Anna, the bartender closest to Aqua Marina. She was absolutely wonderful—always friendly, attentive, and making delicious drinks with a smile.
We also want to recognize the entertainment team, especially Mauricio, Daniel, and Giovani. They made the most fun crafts and activities for our family and helped create memories that our children will be talking about for a long time.
Our concierge, Faredeh, was fantastic. She helped coordinate all of our dinner reservations and made everything seamless from start to finish. Her attention to detail and willingness to help made our stay stress-free and enjoyable.
We also want to give a special thank you to Ivan from Guest Services. He truly made our whole trip by taking the time to come say hi and chat with us whenever he saw us around the resort. His friendliness and genuine interest in making sure we were having a great time made us feel incredibly welcome and added a personal touch that meant so much to our family.
reviews.author: Lema

reviews.text:
While the staff are generally friendly, courteous, and attentive, positive customer service alone does not offset several recurring issues that impacted the overall guest experience. These included extended wait times, frequent elevator outages, excessive noise during the evenings, and disruptive maintenance activity during daytime hours.

Additionally, guest rooms do not include microwaves, making it difficult to reheat room service meals, which often arrived lukewarm or cold. Unfortunately, this was a recurring issue throughout my stay.

During the wet season (typically May through July and often extending into August), the beach appeared to receive limited maintenance. As a result, the private beach was not particularly inviting, and many guests, myself included, were discouraged from swimming or spending time by the water.

While a few menu items at the restaurants were enjoyable, the overall dining experience fell well below expectations. On multiple occasions, dishes were returned because they lacked quality, flavor, or proper preparation.

Having previously visited in 2020, I was disappointed by the noticeable decline in the property's overall standards and guest experience. The difference compared to my prior stay was significant.
reviews.author: Akilah

reviews.text: Beautiful resort inside and out. It is definitely an older building, but the interior is amazing. Aqua Marina was one of the best restaurants and overall food was okay. All the evening shows were great. Staffs are nice and very helpful. Quick room service and response to all the requests. I would recommend this resort!

They were available 24/7, always ready to answer questions, assist with requests, and ensure everything went smoothly. It felt like having a personal guide throughout the entire trip.

Their attention to detail, professionalism, and genuine care made all the difference. I highly recommend Erick and Carolina to anyone considering the Family Concierge experience. They exceeded every expectation and helped create memories that our family will never forget. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.text: Amazing 5-day vacation at the resort (5/5). Pools and bars were great. Only issue is the amount of seaweed on the beach but still wouldn’t stop me from returning 😀

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay with our family (w/ young kids!). Facilities were beautiful and clean! Staff were very friendly and helpful. The highlight of our stay was our concierge, Fernanda, she was absolutely amazing and so helpful. She made our stay feel effortless and was so on top of things which made a big impact on our experience. She was in regular communication and easy to connect with, let us know of resort happenings daily, made all of our dinner reservations ahead of time, reserved us cabanas, set up a special welcome and later a birthday delivery for my husband, took care of everything related to our lagoon sunset cruise, and made sure we were taken care of completely from beginning to end. Our overall experience would not compare without her! She was so easy to communicate with and we saw her daily around the hotel. THANK YOU Fernanda, you're the best! 
Some opportunity for growth in the resort: not all of our friends had the same experience. Some of us were given welcome drinks upon arrival, others were not. Our concierge was fantastic, but our friends had the opposite experience and no service from their concierge. Some of us were given a coupon booklet for things around the resort, and others were not. Would be nice for consistent experience for all. The food could also be elevated. We tried most of the restaurants and buffet and it was okay but nothing too great, seems like a lot of the same basic food. We also wished we could take stuff to go and eat @ the pool

reviews.author: Natalia

reviews.text:
My daughters and I just returned from an incredible stay at Paradisus Cancún, and I cannot say enough wonderful things about the staff and service.

A special thank you to our Family Concierge team, Alejandro and Rommel They were attentive, responsive, professional, and genuinely cared about making our stay memorable. Whether it was answering questions, assisting with reservations, or helping us navigate the resort, they consistently went above and beyond. They made us feel welcomed and valued from the moment we arrived until the day we departed.

The entire staff throughout the resort was exceptional. From the restaurants and bars to housekeeping and guest services, everyone was friendly, hardworking, and eager to help. It is clear that Paradisus has built a culture centered around hospitality and guest experience.

One suggestion I would love to offer is the addition of QR codes for staff tipping. We frequently found ourselves wanting to recognize and reward outstanding service, but we simply ran out of cash. There were several amazing team members we would have loved to tip and thank personally. A secure QR code option would allow guests to easily show appreciation to staff members even when they don't have cash available. I truly believe it would benefit both guests and employees.

Thank you, Paradisus Cancún, for a wonderful graduation celebration trip with my daughter and her friend. We made beautiful memories and look forward to returning in the future.

reviews.text: Our concierges, Galindo and Natalia were very efficient with their care and with making reservations with amazing restaurants. The hotel rooms were clean and the staff were all welcoming.

reviews.text:
Muy mala experiencia con este hotel. Llevo varios días intentando recibir un reembolso que me prometieron y hasta el día de hoy sigo sin recibir mi dinero ni una confirmación clara. Me dijeron que enviarían el reembolso por transferencia bancaria, pero cada vez que pido información solo recibo excusas y retrasos.

Lo más decepcionante es que me pidieron eliminar mi reseña negativa para poder “ayudarme” con el proceso del reembolso. Accedí y eliminé la reseña de buena fe, esperando profesionalismo y cooperación, pero después de hacerlo dejaron de ser claros y sigo sin solución.

La falta de comunicación, transparencia y seguimiento ha hecho toda esta situación muy frustrante. Solo quería recuperar mi dinero y recibir un servicio honesto.

They charged me for a room I never confirmed about . Never AGAIN

reviews.text:
We recently stayed at this all-inclusive resort and had a wonderful experience overall. The property was beautiful, clean, and very well maintained. The staff throughout the resort were friendly, attentive, and always willing to help, which made our stay even more enjoyable.

The food options were excellent with a good variety of restaurants and cuisines to choose from. We especially enjoyed the fresh breakfast selections and evening dining experiences. Drinks were consistently good, and service around the pool and beach was fast and welcoming.

The rooms were comfortable, spacious, and cleaned daily.

Overall, this was a relaxing and enjoyable vacation, and we would definitely consider returning in the future. We would recommend this resort to couples, families, or anyone looking for a stress-free all-inclusive getaway.

reviews.text:
Abril de 2026

Llevé a mi esposa de luna de miel a Paradisus Cancún, en la sección The Reserve.

Escogí este hotel por la estructura de pirámide, algo que lo hacía interesante y único en un lugar donde hay variedad de hoteles… y no me equivoqué. Desde que llegamos, mi esposa se quedó sin palabras; quedó enamorada del lugar. Dato curioso: la estructura principal con techo de cristal fue inspirada en un cenote.

El mejor servicio que recibimos fue el de nuestro concierge llamado Sergio. He went above and beyond para cumplir, satisfacer y exceder nuestras expectativas. Siempre estaba un paso adelante. Si les toca Sergio, no duden en dejarle saber sus peticiones, porque de alguna forma, si estaba en sus capacidades, las cumplía. Siempre fue respetuoso y amable conmigo y con mi esposa. Servicial, atento, siempre con una sonrisa y dispuesto a ayudar.

Nos encantó la experiencia. Restaurantes y buffet deliciosos. Gracias a Sergio y a todos aquellos otros empleados que fueron amables con nosotros.

Honeymoon approved por nosotros; recomendado 100% para pasarla bien y relajados.

reviews.text:
Nous avons passé un beau séjour dans cet hôtel à Cancun. L’endroit est très propre, les femmes de ménage font un excellent travail et la chambre était toujours impeccable. Les piscines sont magnifiques et bien entretenues, et l’hôtel est superbe avec sa végétation intérieure, ce qui crée une ambiance unique.

Cependant, le service est très inégal. Le restaurant italien et le buffet offrent un excellent service, mais ce n’est pas le cas partout. Le petit café a été particulièrement décevant : boissons mal préparées, qualité variable, et certaines excuses peu crédibles concernant des ingrédients disant être manquant mais pourtant visibles sur le comptoir. L’attitude du personnel y laissait aussi à désirer.

Nous avons également remarqué une différence dans l’accueil selon les clients, un accueil minimal pour nous alors que d’autre client semblaient recevoir un accueil beaucoup plus chaleureux ce qui nous a mis mal à l’aise.

Enfin, certaines expériences au restaurant ont été décevantes, avec des plats ne correspondant pas à leur description. J’ai reçu un plat de pâtes blanche, sans sauce. lorsque j’ai demandé un correction j’ai reçu un plat inondé de sauce soya seulement, se qui n’est pas représentatif a la description.

En résumé, l’hôtel est magnifique et très propre, nous nous sommes bien reposée mais le service manque de constance. Avec des améliorations à ce niveau, l’expérience pourrait être excellente.

reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun was nothing short of a dream. From the moment we arrived, everything felt effortless, luxurious, and truly unforgettable. The staff went above and beyond in every interaction warm, attentive, and genuinely dedicated to making our stay perfect.

The resort itself is stunning, with breathtaking views, pristine beaches, and beautifully maintained grounds that make you feel like you’ve stepped into paradise. Every detail, from the rooms to the pools to the dining experiences, was thoughtfully designed and impeccably executed.

The food was incredible, with so many delicious options that we looked forward to every meal. Whether relaxing by the pool, enjoying the beach, or exploring everything the resort has to offer, there was never a dull moment just pure relaxation and happiness.

This trip exceeded every expectation. If you’re looking for a place where everything is taken care of and you can truly unwind, Paradisus Cancun is it. We can’t wait to come back! The only bad part about paradisus was having to leave.

reviews.text:
1.
We stayed for 4 nights as a family of 4 (ages 8 and 9 + parents).

2.
The zoning was cleverly executed; the areas for families with children and exclusively for adults allowed us to enjoy a relaxing stay.

3.
The kids club staff were amazing, and our kids loved the diverse activities - water play, ancient instruments, art craft, dance, and more.

I felt very secure to leave my kids, and they wanted to go back again and again.
It was the perfect balance for a restful stay for parents.

4.
The only downside was mosquitoes. My daughter was bitten 12 times, my son 5 times, and my husband and I were each bitten 4 times, mainly inside the building.

And this happened despite my diligent application of insect repellent from the evening onwards, and even though I used a mosquito repellent inside the room.

This was partly due to the season, and perhaps also because we stayed in a first-floor room. 

5.
Overall, my impression is that—with its magnificent scenery, pleasant staff, tastefully renovated building, and dining that offers good value for the price—this is a place I would happily recommend to my friends and their families.

The concierge Omar was excellent. What stood out most about Omar was his personalized approach—they remembered our preferences and anticipated our needs before we even had to ask.

Omar’s knowledge of the resort and surrounding area was impressive, and they offered great suggestions that made our trip even more memorable. Communication was always prompt, whether in person or via phone/message, which made planning incredibly convenient.

Overall, the concierge service specially Omar exceeded expectations and played a huge role in making our vacation relaxing and enjoyable. I would highly recommend taking advantage of their services if you stay here.

reviews.text:
I would give 5 stars for the coffee shop staff—Rosalia, Perla, and Alejandro. Anna too from the pool area. They are incredibly warm, welcoming, and personable. I truly wish all staff were trained like them.

However, the buffet service needs improvement. One staff member did not offer us drinks because we no longer had our bracelets, even though we explained that we had day pass cards and could still access amenities on our checkout day until 2 pm. It seems some staff are not familiar with this policy, and unfortunately, our table was left unattended. We repeatedly asked for water but were not assisted.

Additionally, the check-in process took almost an hour. There appeared to be many new staff members who were frequently asking each other questions, which caused delays.

Aside from these issues, we really liked the hotel. It’s a great place for families.

reviews.text:
The amazing staff and the beautiful property. The views of the ocean are stunning, and the pools are great, with plenty of options to relax and enjoy the atmosphere.

I would like to give a special mention to Alica, the manager, who was incredibly kind and helpful. I faced a few issues with my room and some situations during our stay, but she handled everything with respect and understanding. The team acknowledged the concerns and genuinely tried their best to resolve them, which I really appreciated.

That said, there are a few areas where improvement is needed. Some of the rules regarding the Bali bed were not clearly explained, which led to confusion. The concierge service could also be more proactive and knowledgeable for families to avoid unnecessary back-and-forth.

Regarding the catering, I believe there is definitely room for improvement. My expectations for the meals were higher, as the food was generally just average. The temperature of the dishes was not always consistent, and at the omelet station, the same oil seemed to be reused, with omelets sometimes coming out dry. The level of professionalism among some of the kitchen staff could also be improved.

Additionally, the spa prices felt unnecessarily high even expensive that Us and did not quite make sense compared to the overall experience other places!!!. This is definitely an area the resort should review and improve to better match guest expectations.

reviews.text:
Overall we had a great trip at Paradisus, especially considering the resort had only been reopened for a few days. 

What we liked: the inside of the resort is beautiful and looks even better at night. The pool is enormous and never felt crowded, even when activities were ongoing. The beach runs the full length of the property, with ample space to enjoy either the sand or sea. The staff were courteous and quick to respond to any requests. Extra credit to the pool bar bartenders who gave equal attention to kids and adults. Our kids loved swimming up and having a frozen drink in their hands in just a few minutes. All of the pool chairs having cushioning was a huge plus, these were some of the most comfortable loungers we’ve experienced anywhere. 

What we’d change: the pool chair “reservations” of early risers taking chairs with only towels early in the morning meant few, if any chairs were available by 10am. Fortunately I’m an early riser and was able to reserve as well, but wish there was a more equitable system/policy that lets late sleepers or afternoon arrivals a place to settle. The food is only ok, not great. Fresh sliced tacos were very enjoyable, but everything else was only so-so. it seemed like the buffet needed more frequent replenishment; I assume this will get better as staffing levels reach normal operating capacity. We ate at capella, blue agave and zesty - we liked blue agave the most, the others were kind of like the buffet, ok but not great.
